card.name: Words leading up to 'pain' or 'hurts'
card.fires_on: Words in general web text where the next word is likely 'pain', 'hurt' or 'wound', such as 'where' before 'it hurts' or 'salt' before 'to their wound'. It also fires on 'the' or 'own' in emotional phrases about loss and suffering.

modes.label: Hurt idioms
modes.description: Words inside set phrases about hurting or wounding, just before the pain word.

modes.label: Emotional loss
modes.description: Words in sad passages about love, grief or loss where 'pain' is the likely next word.
modes.example: she feels the<< pain>> of unfulfilled expectations

modes.label: Love comparisons
modes.description: Comparison words in phrases like 'more than his own life'.
modes.example: Kamrul loves his children<< more>> than his own life.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word pain, in English, Chinese and Japanese.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up the word 'pain' or 'hurt' in sad or emotional passages.
